jy-industry-research-summary v1.0.0 – Initial release

- Enables fast, structured broker industry research report summaries via 聚源数据 MCP.
- Supports querying by industry keyword, time range, and select 12 broker firms.
- Outputs key perspectives: industry trends, competition, tech innovation, policy, investment, and risk, keeping original report text.
- Provides detailed setup and configuration guide for mcporter and MCP API.
- Ensures all results are structured in standardized JSON format with traceable publishing info.
